title: Ease of driving and general usability
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly praise the G70 for being easy to drive and get used to, while a few complaints focus on confusing functions and difficult app or feature use.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe easy driving, parking, entry and exit, quick adaptation, helpful grip, and straightforward highway merging aided by acceleration.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on difficulty using certain car functions, figuring out how systems work, and logging into the app.

limitations: The topic blends easy-driving feedback with broader usability comments about app access and in-car features, so it is not a single tightly focused theme.
One positive fragment expresses an expectation about an easy way to export videos rather than clearly confirming satisfaction with that feature, so its exact implication is limited.
